meanings.en: a loud, confused noise, especially caused by a large crowd
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd's tumult drowned out the speaker's voice.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalığın gürültüsü konuşmacının sesini bastırdı.

meanings.en: a state of confusion, excitement, or emotional disturbance
meanings.exampleEn: Her mind was in a tumult after hearing the news.
meanings.exampleTr: Haberi duyduktan sonra zihni büyük bir çalkantı içindeydi.

meanings.en: having a pleasant tune; melodious
meanings.exampleEn: The band played a tuneful melody that everyone hummed along to.
meanings.exampleTr: Grup, herkesin mırıldandığı ahenkli bir melodi çaldı.

meanings.en: not having a pleasant tune; not melodious
meanings.exampleEn: He sang a tuneless song in the shower.
meanings.exampleTr: Duşta ahenksiz bir şarkı söyledi.

meanings.en: to make a device or machine start working by pressing a button or switch
meanings.exampleEn: Please turn on the lights, it's getting dark.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen ışıkları aç, hava kararıyor.

meanings.en: to suddenly attack or become hostile toward someone
meanings.exampleEn: The dog suddenly turned on its owner.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek aniden sahibine saldırdı.

meanings.en: a person who deserts one party or cause to join an opposing one
meanings.exampleEn: He was branded a turncoat for switching to the rival party.
meanings.exampleTr: Rakip partiye geçtiği için dönek olarak damgalandı.

meanings.en: a time at which a decisive change in a situation occurs
meanings.exampleEn: Winning that award was a turning point in her career.
meanings.exampleTr: O ödülü kazanmak kariyerinde bir dönüm noktasıydı.

meanings.en: the number 12
meanings.exampleEn: There are twelve months in a year.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir yılda on iki ay vardır.

meanings.en: the number 20
meanings.exampleEn: She turned twenty last week.
meanings.exampleTr: Geçen hafta yirmi yaşına girdi.

meanings.en: the soft light in the sky after the sun has set
meanings.exampleEn: We walked home through the fields at twilight.
meanings.exampleTr: Alacakaranlıkta tarlaların arasından eve yürüdük.

meanings.en: a period of gradual decline near the end of something
meanings.exampleEn: He spent the twilight of his career coaching young players.
meanings.exampleTr: Kariyerinin son döneminde genç oyuncuları çalıştırdı.

meanings.en: a sudden, sharp, brief pain
meanings.exampleEn: She felt a twinge in her back when she lifted the box.
meanings.exampleTr: Kutuyu kaldırırken sırtında ani bir sancı hissetti.

meanings.tr: kısa süreli hoş olmayan duygu (vicdan, pişmanlık)
meanings.en: a brief, unpleasant feeling of an emotion
meanings.exampleEn: He felt a twinge of guilt for forgetting her birthday.
meanings.exampleTr: Doğum gününü unuttuğu için bir an vicdan azabı hissetti.

meanings.en: (of a bird) to make a series of short, high sounds
meanings.exampleEn: Birds twitter in the garden every morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuşlar her sabah bahçede cıvıldar.

meanings.tr: heyecanla çabuk çabuk konuşmak, çene çalmak
meanings.en: to talk rapidly in a nervous or excited way
meanings.exampleEn: The children twittered excitedly about the trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar gezi hakkında heyecanla çene çaldılar.

meanings.en: a violent tropical storm with strong winds, occurring in the western Pacific
meanings.exampleEn: The typhoon destroyed hundreds of homes along the coast.
meanings.exampleTr: Tayfun kıyı boyunca yüzlerce evi yıktı.

meanings.en: using power in a cruel and unfair way
meanings.exampleEn: The people rose up against the tyrannical ruler.
meanings.exampleTr: Halk zalim yöneticiye karşı ayaklandı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows no embarrassment or shame
meanings.exampleEn: She is unabashedly ambitious about her goals.
meanings.exampleTr: Hedefleri konusunda çekinmeden hırslıdır.

meanings.en: (of a text) complete and not shortened
meanings.exampleEn: I listened to the unabridged audiobook of the novel.
meanings.exampleTr: Romanın kısaltılmamış sesli kitabını dinledim.

meanings.en: to a degree that is too bad to be allowed or approved
meanings.exampleEn: The waiting times were unacceptably long.
meanings.exampleTr: Bekleme süreleri kabul edilemez derecede uzundu.

meanings.en: not having anyone with you; alone
meanings.exampleEn: Unaccompanied children cannot board the flight.
meanings.exampleTr: Refakatsiz çocuklar uçağa binemez.

meanings.en: (of music or singing) performed without instrumental accompaniment
meanings.exampleEn: She sang an unaccompanied folk song.
meanings.exampleTr: Eşliksiz bir halk şarkısı söyledi.

meanings.en: impossible to explain or understand
meanings.exampleEn: For some unaccountable reason, the machine stopped working.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşılmaz bir sebeple makine çalışmayı durdurdu.

meanings.en: not required to explain or justify actions to anyone
meanings.exampleEn: The committee is unaccountable to the public.
meanings.exampleTr: Komite kamuya karşı hesap vermek zorunda değildir.

meanings.en: not officially recognized or approved by an authorized body
meanings.exampleEn: The degree came from an unaccredited university.
meanings.exampleTr: Diploma akredite olmamış bir üniversiteden alınmıştı.

meanings.en: pure; not mixed with any other substance
meanings.exampleEn: The product is made from unadulterated honey.
meanings.exampleTr: Ürün katıksız baldan yapılmıştır.

meanings.en: complete; used to emphasize a quality or feeling
meanings.exampleEn: The film was unadulterated nonsense.
meanings.exampleTr: Film su katılmamış bir saçmalıktı.

meanings.en: not changed or influenced by something
meanings.exampleEn: The northern regions were unaffected by the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuzey bölgeleri fırtınadan etkilenmedi.

meanings.en: genuine and natural in manner; not pretentious
meanings.exampleEn: Despite her fame, she remained warm and unaffected.
meanings.exampleTr: Ününe rağmen sıcak ve yapmacıksız kaldı.

meanings.en: complete and not spoiled by anything; pure
meanings.exampleEn: The news brought them unalloyed joy.
meanings.exampleTr: Haber onlara katıksız bir sevinç getirdi.

meanings.tr: açık ve net biçimde, hiçbir kuşkuya yer bırakmadan
meanings.en: in a way that is clear and has only one possible meaning
meanings.exampleEn: The contract states unambiguously who is responsible.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşme kimin sorumlu olduğunu açıkça belirtir.

meanings.en: not feeling or showing gratitude or recognition of value
meanings.exampleEn: He was unappreciative of all the help she gave him.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona verdiği onca yardıma karşı değerbilmezdi.

meanings.en: not friendly or easy to talk to
meanings.exampleEn: The manager seemed cold and unapproachable.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür soğuk ve mesafeli görünüyordu.

meanings.en: not good at or interested in sports; not physically fit
meanings.exampleEn: He was clumsy and unathletic as a child.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukken sakar ve spora yatkın değildi.

meanings.en: not mixed together with other things; from a single source
meanings.exampleEn: They sell unblended single-origin coffee.
meanings.exampleTr: Karıştırılmamış tek kaynaklı kahve satıyorlar.

meanings.en: not marked with the name of a particular producer; without a brand
meanings.exampleEn: Unbranded products are usually cheaper than named ones.
meanings.exampleTr: Markasız ürünler genellikle markalı olanlardan daha ucuzdur.

meanings.en: to undo the buckle of a belt or strap
meanings.exampleEn: He unbuckled his seatbelt before the car had stopped.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba durmadan önce emniyet kemerinin tokasını açtı.

meanings.en: not having official certification or approval
meanings.exampleEn: The company hired an uncertified electrician.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket belgesiz bir elektrikçi işe aldı.

meanings.en: not able to be changed
meanings.exampleEn: The rules of the contest are fixed and unchangeable.
meanings.exampleTr: Yarışmanın kuralları sabit ve değiştirilemez.

meanings.en: (of information) not secret; available to the public
meanings.exampleEn: The report was based on unclassified documents.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor gizli olmayan belgelere dayanıyordu.

meanings.en: not arranged into groups or categories
meanings.exampleEn: Several species remain unclassified by scientists.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç tür bilim insanlarınca hâlâ sınıflandırılmamıştır.

meanings.en: to remove a blockage from something
meanings.exampleEn: He used a chemical to unclog the kitchen drain.
meanings.exampleTr: Mutfak giderinin tıkanıklığını açmak için bir kimyasal kullandı.

meanings.en: unwound from a coiled or curled shape; straightened out
meanings.exampleEn: The uncoiled rope lay stretched across the deck.
meanings.exampleTr: Çözülmüş halat güvertenin bir ucundan diğerine uzanıyordu.

meanings.en: not having decided to support a particular person, party, or plan
meanings.exampleEn: Many voters remain uncommitted before the election.
meanings.exampleTr: Seçim öncesinde birçok seçmen hâlâ kararsız.

meanings.en: the quality of being rare or unusual
meanings.exampleEn: The uncommonness of the disease makes it hard to diagnose.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalığın nadirliği teşhisini zorlaştırıyor.

meanings.en: unwilling to talk or give information
meanings.exampleEn: He became silent and uncommunicative after the argument.
meanings.exampleTr: Tartışmadan sonra sessiz ve ketum biri oldu.

meanings.en: lacking confidence or self-assurance
meanings.exampleEn: She felt unconfident speaking in front of a large audience.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük bir kalabalık önünde konuşurken özgüvensiz hissetti.

meanings.en: impossible to defeat or overcome
meanings.exampleEn: They showed an unconquerable spirit throughout the war.
meanings.exampleTr: Savaş boyunca yenilmez bir ruh sergilediler.

meanings.en: the quality of not following what is usual or traditional
meanings.exampleEn: Her unconventionality made her stand out among her peers.
meanings.exampleTr: Alışılmışın dışında oluşu, onu akranları arasında öne çıkardı.

meanings.en: not fashionable, impressive, or socially acceptable
meanings.exampleEn: He thought wearing a helmet was uncool.
meanings.exampleTr: Kask takmayı havalı bulmuyordu.

meanings.tr: yanılgısından kurtarmak, gözünü açmak, gerçeği göstermek
meanings.en: to tell someone the truth and free them from a false belief
meanings.exampleEn: I hate to undeceive you, but the story simply isn't true.
meanings.exampleTr: Seni yanılgından kurtarmak istemezdim ama bu hikâye kesinlikle doğru değil.

meanings.en: never having been beaten in a competition or contest
meanings.exampleEn: The team finished the season undefeated.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım sezonu yenilgisiz tamamladı.

meanings.en: a person who performs less well than expected, especially in school
meanings.exampleEn: He was a bright but lazy underachiever at school.
meanings.exampleTr: Okulda zeki ama tembel, kapasitesinin altında bir öğrenciydi.
